prose.text: DLP has three layers, and a question about "why did or didn't DLP act" has to be asked in order.

steps.label: What is detected?
steps.text: Dictionaries are the detection primitives ([[zia.dlp.dictionaries]]). They are grouped into engines with Boolean expressions ([[zia.dlp.engines]]), and a rule references engines, not dictionaries ([[zia.dlp.engines:rules-reference-engines]]).

steps.label: Which rule applies and what does it do?
steps.text: Order, criteria, Match Only, Confirm and the save-time constraints are in [[zia.dlp.rules]]; the API names and enums are in [[zia.dlp.rule-wire-shape]].

steps.label: Was DLP reached, and in which mode?
steps.text: Upstream blocks, the decrypt dependency, Evaluate All Rules mode, exception rules and exemptions are in [[zia.dlp.evaluation]], with the SSL side in [[zia.ssl-inspection.pipeline]] and the URL side in [[zia.url-filtering]]. If DLP was reached but a large file was not inspected, see [[zia.dlp.inspection-limits]].

prose.text: Authoring a custom Patterns & Phrases dictionary is in [[zia.dlp.dictionary-patterns]], the Index Tool that builds EDM and IDM index templates in [[zia.dlp.index-tool]], Exact Data Match templates and dictionaries in [[zia.dlp.exact-data-match]], Indexed Document Match templates in [[zia.dlp.indexed-document-match]], and Microsoft Information Protection accounts and label retrieval in [[zia.dlp.mip-labels]].

After a match, notification, ICAP, Incident Receiver and Cloud-to-Cloud forwarding are in [[zia.dlp.incident-forwarding]], and the auditor email templates and their macros are in [[zia.dlp.notification-templates]]. The ICAP receivers are in [[zia.dlp.icap-receivers]], the Incident Receiver's deployment in [[zia.dlp.incident-receiver]] and Cloud-to-Cloud storage onboarding in [[zia.dlp.cloud-to-cloud-forwarding]].

Endpoint DLP and Outbound Email DLP are separate API families: [[zia.dlp.endpoint-dlp]], [[zia.dlp.outbound-email]]. How Outbound Email DLP policy works is in [[zia.dlp.outbound-email-policy]], its email tenants and mail-server setup in [[zia.dlp.outbound-email-tenants]], and the domain and recipient profiles in [[zia.dlp.email-profiles]].

How Endpoint DLP policy reaches endpoints and a rule is chosen is in [[zia.dlp.endpoint-enforcement]], its rules in [[zia.dlp.endpoint-rules]], its resources in [[zia.dlp.endpoint-resources]] and its settings in [[zia.dlp.endpoint-settings]]. Endpoint Data Scan reports are in [[zia.dlp.endpoint-data-scan]], the endpoint inventory in [[zia.dlp.endpoint-inventory]], Endpoint IDM, EDM and Share Files Externally in [[zia.dlp.endpoint-sensitive-information]], Indicators of Intent in [[zia.dlp.endpoint-intent]], and Device Control in [[zia.dlp.endpoint-device-control]]. Endpoint Context, the application telemetry that shares the resources page, is in [[zia.endpoint-context]].
Paging pitfalls for ZIA lists are in [[shared.sdk-go.list-pagination]].

checks.do: Whether the evaluation mode is known and the rule list is complete before reasoning over a tenant's inline DLP rules.
